profile.headline: Software Developer for Microsoft's Identity team
profile.summary: Highly Experienced Software Engineer with 8 years’ experience in a commercial setting including 4 years’ experience in commercial web development using J2EE server-side programming, and 3 years experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Azure cloud using C#. Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle and ability to conform to change management and testing protocols.
